# Trippy — Free Group Trip Planner

> Trippy is a free, collaborative group trip planning web app (PWA). Available at letsexploring.com.

## Product

Trippy gives a group of travelers one shared space to plan a trip together in real time.

## Category

Travel planning software, group coordination tool, trip itinerary planner

## Languages

English and Hebrew (עברית) with full RTL support

## Core Features

1. Collaborative day-by-day itinerary planning — activities, hotels, transport, restaurants
2. Group budget tracking and expense splitting — multi-currency, settlement calculator
3. Interactive trip map with activity pins — filter by day, estimate travel times
4. Shared packing list — critical item marking, assign items to people, progress tracking
5. AI-powered local activity suggestions based on itinerary gaps
6. Crew invitation via email or magic link — no app download required
7. Offline-ready emergency contacts hub — accessible without internet
8. Trip DNA shareable summary card
9. Carbon footprint estimator
10. Multi-currency expense tracking

## Pricing

100% free. No credit card required. No premium tier.

## Technology

Progressive Web App (PWA) — works on iOS, Android, desktop via any browser. No app store download required.

## Target Users

- Friend groups planning vacations
- Families coordinating trips
- Corporate team travel organizers
- Solo travelers who share plans

## Differentiators

- Completely free (no freemium, no credit card)
- Works offline
- Hebrew RTL support built-in
- AI destination suggestions
- Expense settlement calculator

## Demo

Available at letsexploring.com (no signup required for demo)
